explanation: The C++ object model defines how objects are created, destroyed, and accessed in memory, emphasizing their storage, type, lifetime, and relationships, especially in the context of modern C++ features like polymorphism, subobjects, and storage duration. Understanding the object model is crucial for effective memory management, type safety, and leveraging object-oriented programming principles in C++.
keywords: C++ Object Model, C++ Memory Layout, Object representation, Storage duration
